effect_description_eng: [Start of Your Main Phase] By placing 1 card from your hand under this Tamer, ＜Draw 1＞ and gain 1 memory. [End of Your Turn] By suspending this Tamer, activate 1 of the effects below: ・1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a [Royal Knight] trait card under this Tamer with the cost reduced by 2. ・You may use 1 use cost 5 or higher [Royal Knight] trait Option card from under this Tamer with the cost reduced by 3. (Rule) Name: Also treated as [King Drasil_7D6].
security_effect_description_eng: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
